title: Meeting his wife Tilly in Alexandria
summary: He met Tilly in Alexandria, Louisiana, courted her from age 13 and was married 55 years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: After the fire. Tell me where did you meet Tilly, your beautiful wife, who is such a magnificent lady.
Oh, you met her down south and brought her to Kansas City with you.
She's certainly a favorite person of all of us.
We I started sweethearing with her when I was 13 years old.
Oh, man, fabulous, fabulous. Well, we all miss her greatly, and I know you do.
Oh, yes. We were together 55 years.
